title: Travel: John Lennon – St Thomas to New York City | 1971
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono flew from St Thomas in the Virgin Islands to New York City on 29 July 1971.

They had appeared in court on 27 July for a custody hearing for Ono’s even-year-old daughter Kyoko. Lennon had previously told US immigration officers of his plans to fly on to New York “to promote American Business Interests and for Humanitarian reasons.”
